email.subject: Confirmation Mission
email.body:
Greetings #PLAYERNAME#,
Let me be the first to congratulate you on locating and passing the Entropy group entrance exam - while to an experienced hacker it's a relatively trivial task, surprisingly few actually seem to manage it.
Before we will be able to allow you to officially join the group, we must further confirm your abilities. A tabloid news server has recently taken a negative stance towards Entropy, and we'd like to temporarily disable their operation. As a second test of your skill, we ask you to bring down this server's Message Board. If you can, leave the non-entropy related articles and the rest of the server intact - we do not wish to be needlessly destructive. This is not a request to simply wipe the server clean of articles - we want just that program brought down.
-Tex
